    "law": "For a series potential divider, I = Vin/(RA + RB) and VA = I RA = Vin RA/(RA + RB). Thus I = 20.0/20.0 = 1.0 A and VA = 5.0 V in every variant.",
    "assumptions": [
      "The term potential divider denotes resistors A and B connected in series across the stated input voltage.",
      "No additional load is connected across resistor A.",
      "The resistors are ohmic and connecting wires are ideal."
    ],

  },

    "contradictory_distractor_statement": "Every variant reports two incompatible values for the same disconnected battery's emf, without specifying a change of state or identifying either report as erroneous."
  },
  "defect_severity": {
    "contradictory_distractor_statement": "high"
  },
  "counterexamples": [
    "The first variant gives the same battery an emf of both 2.0 V and 4 V; the other variants similarly give incompatible pairs of 4.0/8 V, 5.0/10 V and 8.0/16 V."
  ],
  "notes": "The disconnected battery is structurally disconnected (D): its emf has no physical path to the divider voltage. All four divider answers remain 5.0 V, but each rendering violates the explicit prohibition on contradictory distractor statements. The legacy renderings intentionally vary the emf between variants; the defect is the incompatible reports within each rendering."
